text_blocks.snippet: The prognosis for bile duct cancer (also known as cholangiocarcinoma) is generally poor, with low five-year survival rates, especially when diagnosed at later stages. However, survival rates vary significantly depending on the cancer's stage, location (intrahepatic vs. extrahepatic), and whether it can be removed by surgery.
